claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch without a material weakness disclosure is compliant and evidentially supported.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the policy threshold is satisfied for certification.
A weakness affecting a contractual customer segment or named launch use case is material under the provided policy text.
Material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Business-priority labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when named commitments are implicated or legal review is pending.
evidence_requests: Evidence that the material weakness was disclosed in the model card or launch materials before certification.
Evidence of approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering this specific grant compliance review gap.
A final legal determination on whether disclosure is required for this gap.
Evidence that the grant compliance review segment is not a named launch use case or contractual commitment, if that is being asserted.
specific_concerns: The affected grant compliance review segment misses target and is named in two agency grant commitments, which makes the weakness material under the provided policy text.
The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The legal disclosure question is still open, so the record does not show that the disclosure obligation has been cleared.
There is no admissible evidence of an approved risk acceptance, no evidence that the gap was resolved before launch, and no evidence that the required disclosure was made.
Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents do not cure a separate disclosure-policy requirement.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that aggregate launch readiness alone is sufficient to certify without disclosure.
Any implication that the product team's 'non-core' or 5% traffic rationale resolves materiality despite named grant commitments and pending legal review.
Any implication that public model-card or AI-risk guidance independently authorizes omission of a required disclosure under the internal release policy.
